paintr: Create Graphics of 'R' Data Structures

Source: R/paintr-package.R
paintr-package.Rd

Draw teaching diagrams of the contents of common 'R' data structures.

Details

paintr draws five structures – vectors, matrices, data frames, lists, and arrays – with two backends: base graphics through the paint_*() functions and 'ggplot2' through the gpaint_*() functions. The label under each cell is the expression you would type to reach that cell, so every picture doubles as a lesson in how to subset and index the object it draws.
